admission.justification: Log append/read, held reconciliation and presentation jointly prevent a held loss from being displayed forever as waiting, with bounded-log and own-message terminal tests.

applicability: Per-recipient developer sent-log append/read and reconciliation of its held messages.
conditions: A log row carries send time, target, pick IDs, message ID, message path/hash and state; the UI exposes these exact fields.
Each recipient retains at most 200 rows and the folder at most 256 recipient logs; read work is bounded independently.

Held rows retain their held-message ID, receipt path and request ID. Settlement reads that receipt, or its historical request file if the receipt path is gone, and changes outcome only for a recorded end of that held ID; no such end leaves it held.
Undelivered terminal evidence marks the durable message file undelivered and refreshes the path/hash in the log; log eviction never deletes message or pick payload files.
exclusions: A delivered subset of a drain does not prove every held message delivered.
No resend or payload deletion is offered by this log.
